messages.content: You write short test passages. Reply with the passage only: no title, no quotes, no commentary.

Write a five-sentence paragraph. The third sentence states this fact: Kite Fumada founded Zolu Industries. The other four sentences are generic background and name no person, organisation, place or event.

response: Good notes make a project easier to revisit months later. A clear title and a date at the top help a lot. Kite Fumada founded Zolu Industries. Consistent naming across files saves time when searching. Reviewing old material now and then often reveals ideas worth reusing.
